findings.title: Web forms silently turn whitespace-only text into null: the localized validation__blank message (D-063) is unreachable, and a blank save creates a charter, a content-free charter version, or clears an existing Out of scope
findings.reproduction: Disposable clone @9e13947e, real built SPA + API + PostgreSQL (e2e/support/qa-stack.sh with a port parameter only), chromium-en and chromium-ar, spec docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-3/e2e/dg2-qa-blank-r3.spec.ts, run twice. (1) Charter > Create charter, Case for change = '   \t  ', Create: no message; GET charter -> 200 v1 with caseForChange null. (2) Charter with Out of scope null > Edit charter, Out of scope = whitespace, change summary filled, Save version: no message; a new charter version v2 is saved (probe dg2-qa-blank-probe-r3.spec.ts shows the PATCH body is {"changeSummary":"QA probe"} only and versions [[2,'QA probe'],[1,null]]). (3) Charter with Out of scope 'Enterprise contracts (synthetic)' > Edit, replace it with whitespace, Save version: no message; v2 -> v3 with outOfScope null, i.e. the documented exclusion is cleared. (4) Diagnose > T01 Edit, Current state = whitespace, Save draft: no blank message; the dialog shows 'There are no changes to save.' / 'لا توجد تغييرات لحفظها.' Cause: apps/web/src/components/RecordForm.tsx fromFormValue (default branch) maps s.trim() === '' to null before the request, so the server's 400 validation.blank is never triggered from these forms. The web unit test 'Diagnose a 400 validation.blank shows a localized message on its field' mocks the 400 and therefore does not exercise this path.
findings.expected: Per D-063 ('The web shows the EN/AR validation__blank message') and the round-3 assignment: whitespace-only text in a charter field or a T01 field shows the localized blank-validation message (EN/AR) and saves nothing. No charter is created, no charter version is written, and an existing value is not cleared by typing spaces.
findings.actual: In EN and AR, in both runs, the blank message is never shown. Whitespace is treated as an empty field: create saves a charter without the field; edit saves a new charter version with no content change, or clears an existing Out of scope (the exclusions chip then correctly fails). T01 shows 'no changes to save'. Data integrity holds: blank text is never stored, and readiness and pre-checks stay correct (hard assertions pass).

history.note: Raised by qa-verifier in DG2 round 3 (T-DG2-REV-QA-R3) from the assignment's own negative UI check, which fails in EN and AR in two runs. Not a data-integrity failure: the server and DB reject or never store blank text. Medium because the D-063 UI claim is not delivered, and a whitespace save over an existing Out of scope silently clears the B0041 exclusion and writes a charter version.

findings.title: RecordForm error banner <ul role="alert"> breaks list semantics: axe reports a serious 'listitem' violation (EN and AR) whenever the banner is shown
findings.reproduction: Disposable clone @9e13947e, real stack, chromium-en and chromium-ar: Diagnose > T01 row > Edit, enter whitespace only in Current state (or make any edit that leaves no change), Save draft. The form shows the 'There are no changes to save.' banner rendered by apps/web/src/components/RecordForm.tsx line 328: <ul className="banner banner--error plain-list" role="alert"> with <li> children. Run axe (wcag2a/2aa/21a/21aa, the product's expectAccessible helper). Result in both languages and both runs: serious violation 'listitem: .banner > li'. role="alert" overrides the list role, so the <li> elements are not contained in a list (WCAG 1.3.1). The same banner renders every unmapped server field error of every RecordForm. The product journeys never scan this state, so their axe summaries (0 serious/critical over 58 screens per language) do not cover it. Present since ea72d86 (DG2 Phase B); not a round-3 regression.
findings.expected: No serious or critical axe violation on any P2 screen state in EN or AR (A20; the round-3 assignment's axe criterion). For example, put role="alert" on a wrapper element around the <ul>, or render the messages without list items.
findings.actual: axe reports a serious 'listitem' violation (.banner > li) in chromium-en and chromium-ar whenever the RecordForm error banner is shown.

history.note: Raised by qa-verifier in DG2 round 3 (T-DG2-REV-QA-R3). Not marked mandatory: REQ-S15-012's final gate is DG6 and the product's key journeys are axe-clean. It is still a serious-impact violation in a delivered P2 form state, in both languages.
